mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign parent company

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent competent authority of the foreign parent's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening before onboarding and throughout the relationship for all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, counterparties, source-of-funds providers, and trade-finance parties against the OFAC SDN List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK Financial Sanctions Targets List, and PRC domestic lists including the List of Untrustworthy Entities and PBOC risk classification systems. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates, with senior-management approval and transaction monitoring for matcha powder trade proceeds, deep beneficial-ownership discovery under PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, and immediate suspension of filing if any sanction match is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Reservation System via the National Enterprise Registration Service Platform (https://zwfw.samr.gov.cn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be registered in standardized simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier naming convention: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry description, and organizational form. Foreign-invested enterprises may use a Chinese transliteration of the foreign parent's brand as the distinctive name, but the Chinese name controls for all domestic regulatory, tax, customs, and banking purposes. An English company name may be reported for record in the business license and public filings, but it does not replace the Chinese legal name. Romanized names, mixed Chinese and English tokens, and non-Han script are not accepted as the registered legal name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: After a rejection notice is issued, the applicant must first review the stated prohibited or sensitive token, amend the proposed name on the National Enterprise Name Reservation System, and re-file without fee. If the refusal is based on an existing registered-rights conflict, the applicant may submit a priority claim supported by a notarized authorization from the existing registrant. Within 60 days from the written rejection, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the next-higher SAMR authority or the same-level people's government under the Administrative Reconsideration Law. Alternatively, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent People's Court within six months. If no rejection exists, the applicant may request a name-reservation extension on the portal before the expiry of the initial 30-day window, subject to SAMR approval.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for this WFOE, which will conduct physical wholesale distribution of organic matcha powder under ISIC 4631 and NAICS 424490. SAMR requires a definite and identifiable business premises supported by a valid lease agreement, property ownership certificate, or, in an approved free trade zone, a staffed incubator desk arrangement. Tax registration requires proof of actual business premises, and Chinese banks perform physical on-site KYC visits before corporate account opening. A licensed shared-office or serviced-office address in Shanghai or Beijing may be accepted only if it includes a physical desk, official signage, staffed mail handling, and evidence of commercial substance, but pure mailbox services will be rejected by tax authorities, SAMR, and banks as lacking a principal place of business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist and quantified risk: Medium-High, estimated at 60% for unannounced on-site inspection within the first 18 months for a cross-border matcha trading WFOE, rising to 85% if a shared or virtual address is used. Checklist: [1] affix the approved company nameplate at the registered premises; [2] maintain a signed lease and landlord property certificate; [3] ensure utility usage is consistent with stated staffing and operations; [4] retain physical or electronic books, invoices, customs declarations, and matcha sourcing or distribution contracts at the premises; [5] permit SAMR and municipal tax inspectors immediate access; [6] maintain warehouse or logistics evidence consistent with the wholesale trade business; [7] keep the legal representative reachable for inspection. Municipal tax authorities also conduct swift inspections when abnormal invoicing risks or missing-person registry flags are triggered.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Revision), Articles 23, 25, 30, 36, 37 and 46; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 6, 15 and 30; Regulations on Foreign Investment Information Reporting; Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Amendment), Articles 35 and 65, for ancillary food wholesale licensing
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation and the local Market Supervision Administration having jurisdiction over the registered office of the wholly foreign-owned enterprise
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application Form and Articles of Association, submitted through the unified enterprise registration online portal or the local Market Supervision Administration service hall
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to this non-restricted-sector WFOE. The registered capital stated in the Articles of Association is legally binding and must be contributed by the shareholder within the deadline set in the Articles. There is no statutory blocked escrow account requirement; however, all inward capital remittances must be made through a foreign exchange capital account and reported under the SAFE Foreign Direct Investment registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [●] TRADING CHINA COMPANY LIMITED, adopted by unanimous written consent of all directors effective as of [●]. WHEREAS, the Company was duly incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the Company Law of the PRC and the Foreign Investment Law of the PRC; and WHEREAS, the sole shareholder has subscribed for all registered shares and has appointed the founding directors; NOW, THEREFORE, it is RESOLVED as follows: 1. Share Capital Subscription. The Board acknowledges receipt of the subscription documentation and confirms that the entire registered capital of USD [●] has been subscribed by the sole shareholder. The Board authorizes the Chief Financial Officer to open domestic capital contribution accounts and to process the lawful inflow of capital through the foreign exchange bank under the foreign direct investment settlement system. Any contribution payment shall be made in accordance with the approved capital schedule and verified by an eligible accountant. 2. Adoption of Registered Office. The Board adopts the registered office located at [●] as the Company's statutory registered address. The Board authorizes the legal representative and the administrative officer to execute the lease, obtain the certificate of property ownership or the landlord's written consent, and file the registered address with the Market Supervision Administration. The registered office may not be changed except by further resolution of the Board. 3. Banking and Signatory Authorization. The following persons are jointly authorized to open, manage, and close bank accounts: Director A, General Manager B, and Finance Controller C. Any instruction exceeding RMB [●] shall require the joint signature of two authorized signatories. The corporate seal, financial seal, legal representative's seal, and invoice seal shall be kept separately by appointed custodians. The Board authorizes the opening of one settlement account and one foreign currency capital account for cross-border matcha procurement payments. 4. Appointment of Statutory Officers. The Board appoints [Name] as Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative, [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Finance Officer, and [Name] as Supervisor. Each officer is vested with the powers required to perform statutory duties and to execute contracts, filings, returns, declarations, and regulatory correspondence on behalf of the Company. 5. Operational Ratifications. The Board ratifies all pre-incorporation contracts entered into for the benefit of the Company and directs management to complete tax registration, customs registration, food business licensing, imported food consignee filing, and all post-incorporation approvals. The Board confirms that this Resolution is effective immediately, may be signed in counterparts, and is authenticated by the signatures of the directors and the corporate seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Business Scope Definition
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation online enterprise registration portal and the local Market Supervision Administration service hall
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Reserve a corporate name and confirm that the proposed name is not identical to an existing PRC-registered entity. Submit three preferred Chinese names and one English name through the unified enterprise registration online portal or the local service hall. State the intended business scope using the standardized wholesale trade formulation for culinary and ceremonial grade matcha. The sole shareholder must provide a scanned copy of its valid certificate of incorporation and the passport or identity document of the proposed legal representative. The registry will issue a name pre-approval notice, generally valid for six months, and the name and business scope must correspond exactly to the later registration application.
required_dossiers: Proposed company names in Chinese and English
Passport copy of proposed legal representative
Certificate of incorporation of foreign sole shareholder
Business scope description in standardized wording
Power of attorney for name reservation agent if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because of identical or deceptively similar registration of a third party, select a substitute name from the reserved alternatives and re-submit on the same platform. If refusal is based on a restricted business-scope word, amend the scope description to the standard wholesale wording and re-file without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration having jurisdiction over the WFOE registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the formal incorporation application with the local Market Supervision Administration using the completed Company Registration Application Form, Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder, and all notarized foreign-investor corporate documents bearing PRC embassy or consulate legalization or apostille, with certified Chinese translation. Execute the appointment instruments for the first board of directors, legal representative, general manager and supervisor. Provide a lease contract, property ownership certificate, or landlord consent for the registered address. If electronic signatures are not adopted, the sole shareholder must appoint an authorized agent by notarized power of attorney. After issuance of the business license the company is legally established and may pre-open bank accounts and apply for tax and customs registrations. The registration authority does not impose minimum paid-in capital; however, capital contribution deadlines must be stated in the Articles.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form
Articles of Association countersigned by sole shareholder
Notarized certificate of incorporation and good standing of foreign investor
Apostille or PRC consulate legalization of foreign company documents
Certified Chinese translation of foreign documents
Lease contract and property ownership or landlord consent certificate
Appointment instruments for directors and statutory officers
Passport copies of directors and authorized signatories
Notarized power of attorney for registration agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Market Supervision Administration issues a supplementary notice for missing or inconsistent documents, cure all deficiencies within fifteen working days by re-notarizing and uploading the corrected package. If rejection states that the business scope includes a prohibited sector, delete the restricted item, revise the Articles, and file a fresh application with expedited priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal, Bank Account Opening and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PBOC-licensed commercial bank acting as a delegated State Administration of Foreign Exchange institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Utilize the newly issued business license to open a basic deposit account at a PBOC-licensed commercial bank and a separate foreign currency capital account for inward foreign direct investment. The bank will complete the SAFE FDI registration and issue the foreign exchange capital account facilitation. The sole shareholder transfers registered capital promptly under the Articles of Association, and the bank verifies the funds through the capital account system. The General Manager must instruct the bank to perform customer due diligence on matcha suppliers, beneficial owners, and signature mandates. For cross-border payments, provide purchase orders, pro-forma invoices, organic certificates, and transport documents. The corporate seal must be procured from a licensed seal engraving unit after registration.
required_dossiers: Business license original
Corporate seal registration certificate
Approval for making corporate seals from licensed engraver
Board resolution appointing bank signatories
Articles of Association
Passports of authorized bank signatories
FDI information registration acknowledgement from SAFE
Lease contract for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank holds the account opening for KYC or compliance reasons, provide source of funds certificates, senior management resumes, updated beneficial ownership charts, and any bank-specific declarations. If SAFE registration is rejected, have the bank correct the investment category or financial code and submit an amended registration through the bank within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Customs, Food Business Licensing and Post-Incorporation Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration local office, General Administration of Customs and local customs house, local Market Supervision Administration food safety unit, and municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete tax registration with the local State Taxation Administration office to obtain a taxpayer identification number, verify tax classification, and apply for general VAT status and electronic invoice quota. Register with the General Administration of Customs and the local customs house for import and export authorization through the National Single Window system, and designate the company as importer of record for matcha shipments. If any domestic wholesale or distribution of food is intended, apply for a Food Business License with the local Market Supervision Administration and complete the imported food consignee filing with GACC. Register with the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau for social insurance, and make statistical, foreign exchange, and industry filings. Maintain food safety documentation, supplier organic certificates, and traceability records from farm to final packaging.
required_dossiers: Business license and Articles of Association
Tax registration application form and financial information forms
Customs registration application and importer of record statement
Food Business License application form
Food safety quality management manual
Matcha supplier organic certificate and certificate of analysis
Traceability and recall procedures
Warehouse or logistics lease contract
Legal representative and customs officer identity documents
Power of attorney for customs broker
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried, submit late registration mitigation evidence and request an extension from the tax authority. If customs registration is suspended, use the Single Window message box to upload missing certificates and request manual review. If the Food Business License application is returned, correct the food safety management files, sanitize the premises, and request a re-inspection within the statutory curing period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation food safety division, local Market Supervision Administration, General Administration of Customs imported food authority, and local Ecology and Environment Bureau if ancillary warehousing or repackaging is introduced
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business License for Food Wholesale and Sales, Imported Food Consignee Registration, and Customs Import and Export Registration

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China with local Ecology and Environment Bureau as accepting authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for pure wholesale and distribution of packaged matcha; no full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is required. If repackaging or cold storage is introduced, the project must file a lower-tier EIA Registration Form under the Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment instead of a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater discharge is expected in pure trade. If wash-down or warehousing occurs, wastewater to municipal sewer must meet GB/T 31962-2015 with pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, and SS not exceeding 400 mg/L. Fugitive volatile organic loading from matcha handling must meet GB 16297-1996 with non-methane total hydrocarbons not exceeding 120 mg/m3 at the boundary, and odors must meet GB 14554-93 with NH3 not exceeding 1.5 mg/m3 and H2S not exceeding 0.06 mg/m3. Expired matcha, contaminated packaging, and used cleaning chemical containers must be stored and disposed of under GB 18597-2023 through a licensed hazardous waste transporter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The local Fire and Rescue Department must accept a fire safety self-certification or issue a fire safety filing acceptance certificate before occupancy of offices or warehousing space. For leased premises without change of use where the area is below the threshold requiring acceptance inspection, a fire safety management filing applies. If storage racks exceed four meters, a structural load verification certificate from a licensed engineer must be maintained. The workplace must post evacuation diagrams, maintain two means of egress, carry out forklift annual inspection and operator licensing if forklifts are used, and submit an occupational safety and hygienic management plan to the Emergency Management Bureau.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); statutory electronic filing console is the national e-Tax Bureau online portal operated by STA and provincial tax service authorities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned WFOE, the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) contained in the SAMR-issued Business License is the statutory TIN/VAT ID; no separate TIN certificate is issued. Procedure: (1) The foreign investor must notarize, legalize or apostille and Chinese-translate its home-country registry documents; (2) file WFOE establishment with the local State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); (3) after the Business License is issued, complete the mandatory tax registration through the e-Tax Bureau within 30 days; (4) declare legal representative, financial officer, tax accountant, accounting standards, bank accounts and invoicing systems; (5) elect general VAT taxpayer status or small-scale taxpayer status based on expected annual sales; (6) apply for export tax rebate qualification and register export collection bank accounts with SAFE if cross-border trade will be performed; (7) use the 18-digit USCC in all VAT filings, VAT invoices, customs declarations and EIT returns. Non-resident enterprises without an establishment in China are not issued a separate TIN unless required for withholding; the Chinese payer executes withholding registration instead.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (the WFOE is a Chinese tax resident enterprise taxed under the Enterprise Income Tax Law; no pass-through treatment applies)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. China has no check-the-box or disregarded-entity election for a WFOE; it is mandatorily an entity-level resident taxpayer. Hybrid mismatch rules are statutory anti-avoidance provisions, not available elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All WFOEs must register for VAT upon incorporation. Mandatory classification as a general VAT taxpayer is triggered when annual VAT-taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; below that threshold the enterprise remains a small-scale VAT taxpayer unless it elects general taxpayer status. Non-resident sellers without a Chinese establishment must either register directly or be covered by a Chinese VAT withholding agent for online sales.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates the Full Digital Electronic Invoice (FDEI) system under Golden Tax Phase IV. Invoices must be issued through the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform and transmitted in real time to STA servers; the system applies anti-fraud digital stamping through unique invoice codes, digital tax seals, and automated clearance validation. Taxpayer ERP systems are required to integrate using STA-published e-invoice APIs. Paper special VAT invoices continue to use tax-control devices with 20-digit invoice codes and tax control data uploads. Failed clearance or invoice code mismatch blocks lawful invoice use and initiates tax risk review.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export zero-rating/export VAT rebate is available when the WFOE is a registered general VAT taxpayer, the matcha powder is actually shipped out of Chinese customs territory under an approved export goods declaration, title and risk have passed to the foreign buyer, export proceeds are repatriated through designated foreign exchange bank channels within the statutory period, valid domestic VAT special input invoices corresponding to the exported batch are held, and the export is reported in the VAT return before the refund claim. The applicable rebate rate is the STA-authorized export rebate rate for the product's tariff line; if the rebate rate is 0%, the export sale is VAT-exempt/zero-rated but the related input VAT is not refundable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (China Customs export goods declaration form with electronic release data)
Bill of Lading (or multimodal transport/air waybill where applicable)
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-exchange export proceeds collection confirmation issued by a SAFE-designated bank
Export Sales Contract or Purchase Order
VAT special invoices for domestic procurement of matcha powder and relevant input services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA electronically cross-checks every zero-rating/export rebate claim against customs declarations, VAT invoice system data and SAFE foreign-exchange receipt data. If zero-rating or rebate is not substantiated, the tax authority recovers the VAT exempted or refunded, assesses late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day, imposes a statutory penalty of 50% to five times the underpaid tax, suspends or cancels the exporter's rebate qualification, and may place the entity on the tax-related credit blacklist. Fraudulent export refunds through forged customs documents, fake export invoices, or fictitious export transactions trigger criminal liability for tax evasion/fraud under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China as well as administrative clawback measures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and its delegated foreign exchange administrative agency, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates a managed float regime for the Renminbi (CNY) with strict bifurcation between current account and capital account transactions. Under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (2008) and SAFE Circulars, current account items, including cross-border payments for trade in goods and services, are generally freely convertible following documentary verification and a legitimate underlying transaction. Export proceeds, however, must be repatriated to China and are subject to a centralized monitoring and verification system; while the mandatory 100% surrender requirement was abolished in 2012, exporters must still route foreign currency receipts through designated foreign exchange accounts and either settle into CNY or retain within approved caps, with all such receipts requiring declaration through the cross-border payment system. Capital account convertibility remains tightly controlled: foreign direct investment into a WFOE requires FDI registration, capital injection via a dedicated capital account, and post-arrival capital verification by a licensed accountant. Profit remittances by a WFOE to its foreign shareholder are treated as current account transfers under dividend distributions, requiring audited financials, tax clearance certificates, and a valid foreign exchange settlement notice issued by the bank after verification of the underlying audited profit and reserve requirements. Practical hurdles include SAFE's 'real demand' principle, which prohibits speculative pre-positioning of funds, and the need for a board resolution and tax withholding certificates before any outward remittance of dividends or liquidation proceeds. Non-trade current transfers such as royalties and management service fees face enhanced scrutiny and require deemed income contracts plus tax payment proof. Overall, the CNY is Highly Convertible on the current account (with controls), but only Partially Convertible on the capital account, mandating a disciplined pre-approval and documentation workflow for every material cross-border fund movement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds of the WFOE, being receipts on current account, must be repatriated into China within 30 days of the date of customs declaration for exportation, unless a SAFE approved extension or special deferred arrangement applies. The current regulatory framework no longer imposes a mandatory fixed conversion ratio; instead, exporters may retain up to the approved foreign exchange settlement account ceiling, with any excess balance required to be converted into CNY. All export receipts must be verified against the customs declarations through the 'Service and Trade Foreign Exchange Administrative Regulations' and reported via the bank under the 'International Receipts and Payments Statistics'. In practice, the bank requires a full set of trade documents (contract, invoice, bill of lading, customs form) and will assign a payment type code (e.g., 'EX01') to each credit. Failure to repatriate within the statutory 30-day window or to produce matching documentation may lead to inclusion on SAFE's 'Focus List' and mandatory 100% surrender of all future receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Capital Injection) and Operational CNY Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Settlement Account (CNY) and Foreign Currency Current Account
Operational Currency Account (CNY) and Export Proceeds Retention Account
General Operating Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs and fintech payment institutions (e.g., Revolut Business, Wise Business, Airwallex, or Payoneer) have a Low viability for serving a Mainland China-based WFOE as a primary banking partner. Under the PRC Law on Commercial Banks and the Non-bank Payment Institution Regulations, only locally licensed commercial banks or authorized non-bank payment institutions operating under a PBOC Payment Business License (Type III for cross-border) may legally hold CNY deposit accounts or facilitate FX settlement for domestic entities. An offshore EMI does not possess a China banking license, cannot maintain a RMB clearing account in the CNAPS system, and cannot directly interface with the SAFE cross-border monitory platform. Accordingly, an offshore EMI may be used solely as a secondary collection channel for foreign customers, provided it obtains a money services business license in its host jurisdiction and the WFOE transfers the collected funds through a SWIFT credit into its own domestic USD/CNY bank account. However, such EMI intermediation introduces a 'payee-payer mismatch' red flag, which significantly raises AML review burden and may be scrutinized by SAFE as potential 'payment splitting' or 'structured settlement'. Therefore, the treasury blueprint mandates that the WFOE maintains its primary liquidity and all trade settlement rails exclusively through Tier-1 domestic commercial banks, with offshore EMIs relegated to test merchant collection only for low-value, high-frequency niche e-commerce sales (not for bulk matcha powder shipments).
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a newly incorporated WFOE in Mainland China, the following physical KYC interview rules apply: the designated legal representative (who may be a non-resident) must physically appear at the chosen bank branch or at the bank's registered window at a licensed representative office in China to execute the account opening agreement and undergo a one-on-one interview with the branch's compliance officer. In exceptional circumstances, where the legal representative is absent due to force majeure or for strategic reasons, a remote consular proxy opening is permissible only if: (1) the legal representative grants a notarized power of attorney to a Chinese-based manager or a qualified third-party attorney; (2) the attorney appears in-branch with the original POA notarized by the Chinese embassy or consulate in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the ultimate shareholder; (3) the bank conducts a video conference interview with the legal representative over an encrypted channel; and (4) the bank receives apostilled corporate certificates and a Board Resolution authorizing the opening. Even with a proxy, the bank retains absolute discretion to reject the application if the ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) structure is opaque. Practically, most Tier-1 Chinese banks insist on at least one physical presence of the senior economic beneficiary or an authorized Chinese officer during the sanction screening and financial crime due-diligence session. Thus the 'physical presence and KYC interview mandate' is rated as 'Generally Mandatory with Proxied Exception' for WFOE treasury account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity due to foreign parent holding chain (e.g., Hong Kong or offshore jurisdiction holdco)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete corporate ownership chart from the ultimate natural-person shareholder down to the WFOE, with each entity's certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, and register of directors and shareholders. For offshore parent companies, supply notarized and apostilled copies of the trust deed or charitable foundation structure (if any), plus a transparency declaration confirming that no nominee shareholders exist. Add signed UBO declarations from all ultimate beneficial owners (holding >=10% equity) with passport copies and recent utility bills or bank references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering risk arising from commodity trade (matcha may be historically listed under 'agricultural products with fungible quality')
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble a comprehensive trade file for the first three shipments: signed Sales/Purchase Contracts indicating Incoterms 2020, commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading (original negotiable forms), customs declarations (Form CCP-30), phytosanitary certificates, proof of quality inspection from an ISO 17025 accredited lab, and an independent logistics chain trace from farm to factory. Additionally, provide a transporter agreement and insurance certificates, and explain any non-standard pricing deviations of >15% from market benchmark prices using a third-party price index.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payer-payee mismatch in cross-border settlement, especially where the Chinese matcha seller collects via a Hong Kong intermediary account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a formal commercial rationale memorandum for the payment routing through the intermediary, including the Hong Kong entity's certificate of incorporation and a valid money service operator license (if applicable). Attach a tri-party agreement among the WFOE, the Hong Kong getter, and the overseas buyer, explicitly authorizing the intermediary to receive and retransmit funds. Provide bank statements of the intermediary for the past 12 months showing that payments originated only from verifiable trade counterparties previously identified in a undertake register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and politically exposed persons (PEP) screening failure due to Chinese counterparty's name matching on global PEP lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a detailed questionnaire signed by the WFOE legal representative indicating nil PEP status for all shareholders and beneficial owners, accompanied by an independent risk-rating report from a recognized commercial database (World-Check, Dow Jones) that resolves the false positive. The bank will also request a sworn affidavit that no goods will be sourced from or sold to comprehensive sanctions jurisdictions (Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Syria, Venezuela, Cuba), along with a commodity end-user attestation confirming the final consumption of matcha powder remains in the food supplement or ceremonial tea sector.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For the WFOE's initial capital contribution from its foreign shareholder, the following compliant routing shall apply. First, the shareholder must register the foreign direct investment with the local Administration for Market Regulation and obtain an FDBusiness License including the 'Foreign Investment Registration' section. Next, within 30 days of becoming an FDI enterprise, the WFOE shall file the 'Foreign Exchange Registration for Direct Investment' with SAFE (through the Chongqing or Shanghai opt-branch where applicable) and receive an FDI-No. Subsequently, the shareholder transfers funds via SWIFT MT103 or Fed-Wire into the WFOE's 'Capital Account - Foreign Currency Settlement' (CNS account) opened at the designated Tier-1 bank. The MT103 field 70 (Remittance Information) must include the FDI registration code, the purpose code 'FDI-IN-11080' (capital injection), and the phrase 'Foreign Direct Investment Capital for Operating Business'. After arrival, the bank will conduct a 'capital verification' within 5 business days, requiring an agreed-upon audit report issued by a licensed Chinese CPA certifying the paid-in capital against the registered paid-in schedule. A portion of the capital, up to the Rmb operational stocking limit, may then be converted into CNY under SAFE's 'Capital Account Income Payment Management' regime, for strictly business operating expenses (rent, salaries, purchase of raw matcha powder, and logistics) – but never for securities, holdings, or real estate. All disbursements from this FDI account must be supported by expense invoices, as the bank applies post-payment random inspections in the 'Business Transaction Monitoring' system. For efficiency, the treasury should maintain a robust Excel-based capital schedule that ties each drawdown to a corresponding operating invoice, ensuring full compliance on forward audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements from the WFOE's operational accounts (current account) may be made using the following clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for general trade settlements (suppliers, logistics providers, and service fees) where the underlying contract value is below open account threshold; (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) issued through the domestic bank via MT700 for larger consignments, particularly if the seller is an overseas matcha farm cooperative requiring irrevocable payment commitments; (3) Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) for established relationships, using the bank's collection instruction via MT400 series. All outbound MT103 credits must include the relevant SAFE purpose code (e.g., 'Prepayment against Goods' or 'Payment for Imported Goods')) and a reference to the customs declaration number or sample contract. For payments to countries with sanctions exposure, the bank will require a supplementary legal opinion from an international law firm confirming that the specific counterparty is not subject to OFAC/EU/UN embargoes. The treasury should pre-register recurring payees with the bank on the entity's 'Payee White-List' and obtain FX payment exemption authorization for any payment exceeding RMB 500,000 equivalent. Trade finance facilities, such as 'Export Collection Bill Discounting' or 'Import L/C financing', may be used to optimize working capital, but each funding transaction increases the bank's scrutiny for trade-based money laundering; thus a full back-to-back documentary chain is mandatory.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Rolling CNY/USD forward contracts (settlement by actual delivery) under the 'real demand' principle, with the underlying trade books (export/import LCs) being the only permitted notional reference.

Non-deliverable forward contracts (NDFs) may only be entered into by Chinese banks with offshore counterparties; onshore WFOEs usually cannot directly transact NDFs, but may, through a domestic bank, access a 'USD/CNY forwards with delivery' instrument hedged via offshore NDFs, provided the final net settlement is conducted in CNY at maturity.

Cross-currency swaps between CNY and major trade currencies (USD, EUR, JPY) for the purpose of synchronizing foreign currency assets/liabilities are permissible, but only when both legs are tied to actual underlying commercial cash flows such as capital injections, dividend repatriation, and import/export receivables/payables, and must obtain a prior 'No Objection' from the SAFE branch if the aggregate notional exceeds USD 10 million.

Zero-cost structured collars and barrier options that embed binary payoffs are prohibited for FX hedging in China due to speculative characteristics; the treasury is limited to plain vanilla forwards and swaps settled through the China Foreign Exchange Trade System (CFETS).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, with data shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) for foreign investment information reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of the following year (annually covering the immediately preceding calendar year); no grace extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the Operation Abnormal Directory within 10 days after the deadline; if unremedied for 3 years, inclusion in the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, triggering multi-sector joint punishments, government procurement restrictions, blacklisting in banking and credit systems, and culminating in administrative revocation of the business license for prolonged non-compliance; administrative fine of up to RMB 30,000 (approximately USD 4,200) may be imposed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the joint SAMR/MOFCOM enterprise annual report filing portal; actual submission is integrated into the Enterprise Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of the following year, covering changes during the reporting year; any change in foreign investment or ownership must additionally be reported within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Rectification order within 30 days; failure to correct results in a fine of up to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 1,400); repeated non-filing leads to inclusion in the foreign investment credit record, denial of foreign exchange bank registration, restrictions on foreign investor profit remittance, and possible judicial enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (Annual Final Settlement and Reconciliation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), local competent tax bureau (surcharge and self-service electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due May 31 of the following year for the preceding tax year; those with a tax year different from the calendar year must file within 5 months after the tax year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 280 to USD 1,400); late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax balance; for deliberate evasion, a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax and criminal referral; continued default may result in asset seizure, tax authority compulsory enforcement, prohibition on outbound clearance for the legal representative, and frozen bank accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements (preparation, audit, and retention at registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No direct government filing; the audited financial statements must be submitted to the shareholders' meeting and retained on-site at the registered office in China for inspection by SAMR, tax authorities, and other regulators upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 4 months after the year-end or prior to the annual shareholders' meeting, which must be convened no later than June 30; the audit engagement must be finalized by April 30 for A-share listed peers, but for a private WFOE the audit report should be available before the annual CIT settlement deadline of May 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violation of the Company Law audit requirement subjects the company to a fine of up to RMB 30,000 (approximately USD 4,200) and the directly responsible persons to a fine of up to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 1,400); the un-audited financial statements cannot legalize the annual report, potentially voiding tax final settlement, blocking credit loan approvals, and triggering administrative sanctions including revocation of business license for serious cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Article 208 of the PRC Company Law imposes a universal, non-waivable annual audit obligation on all companies, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise Limited Liability, with no quantitative balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exceptions. In addition, the following threshold-based events mandate or effectively require an audit-prepared financial package: (i) an enterprise with total assets exceeding RMB 20 million (approximately USD 2.8 million) that is applying for a general taxpayer VAT status or for high-tech enterprise certification must submit a CPA-audited financial statement; (ii) an enterprise with annual turnover exceeding RMB 50 million (approximately USD 7 million) in the wholesale distribution industry is automatically classified as not a 'micro or small enterprise' under the SME classification rules, thereby requiring full PRC Accounting Standards and making externally audited statements the expected norm; (iii) an enterprise with total related-party transactions of RMB 100 million (approximately USD 14 million) or more in a year must prepare contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation, which necessarily includes audited or audit-reviewed financial statements; and (iv) any enterprise that receives a specific tax assessment notice or administrative investigation must present a certified audit report ordered by the tax authority. The absence of a general numeric threshold for the audit obligation confirms that the audit mandate is categorical for all WFOEs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), which are substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for large and medium-sized enterprises; small and micro-sized enterprises (qualifying as such under the SME classification standards, generally with annual revenue below RMB 10 million, total assets below RMB 30 million, or fewer than 50 employees, depending on the industry) may apply the Simplified Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises (2011). The audit, when performed, must be conducted by a licensed CPA firm registered with the Ministry of Finance and the Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants. The annual financial statements must be prepared in accordance with the General Chart of Accounts and other MOF pronouncements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not have a separate annual UBO declaration form. The Administrative Measures for Beneficial Owner Information Filing (effective March 1, 2024) require a WFOE to conduct a one-time beneficial owner identification and filing with the SAMR system within 30 days after establishment, and to update the filing within 30 days after any change to shareholding, voting rights, senior management appointment, or other change that alters beneficial ownership. The annual Enterprise Annual Report, due by June 30 each year, must include current equity structure, shareholder changes, promoter contributions, and the actual controller information, thereby serving as the annual confirmation point: if no ownership change occurred in the prior year, the submission of the annual report (including the full shareholder list and registered capital details) constitutes the confirmatory declaration; if a share transfer or ownership change did occur, a timely SAMR equity registration change must be completed within 30 days of the transaction. The WFOE must also notify the tax bureau of any change in control for corporate income tax, stamp duty, and natural-person income tax withholding purposes.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 8,500 per year (typical annual fee range for a registered office address, legal streak maintenance, local filing agent, and domicile services in or around China; actual lease costs for physical office space are higher, varying between USD 5,000 and USD 40,000 per year for a matcha trading WFOE depending on city and class of office)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - USD 5,500 per year for a standard small-to-medium wholesale trading WFOE engaged in matcha powder import and distribution, excluding transfer pricing documentation or special consolidated reporting complexities; the fee range assumed the use of a tier-2 CPA firm in a first-tier city, with higher fees for USD-driven consolidated IFRS-style audit reports or parent-company-driven procedures.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25% rate applies to the WFOE; no automatic WFOE tax holiday. Small low-profit entities may achieve an effective 5% rate on taxable income up to RMB 3 million through the 20% preferential rate and 25% taxable-income inclusion, subject to annual legislative renewal. High-tech enterprises may apply 15%; R&D expense qualifying activities may benefit from a 100% additional deduction. Hainan Free Trade Port cannot be assumed from jurisdiction alone. The matcha distribution trade qualifies for no special patent box, but standard preferential CIT regimes may apply if eligibility is independently satisfied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return, Category A) with supporting schedules A105000, A105080, A107012, A108010, A109010, and the quarterly prepayment Form A200000, all filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the enterprise must also make quarterly advance CIT payments, followed by the annual final settlement and filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly advance payments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual return and final settlement must be filed within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., no later than May 31 of the following year for a December 31 year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate revenue from the sale of organic-matcha powder, culinary and ceremonial grades, export distributions and auxiliary supply-chain services, before deduction of costs and taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise and must include worldwide revenue. For cross-border sales, convert foreign currency into RMB using the bookkeeping exchange rate consistent with tax rules; do not record merely the net cash received if rebates are deducted from gross sales, and reconcile any intercompany revenue charged to the foreign parent to ensure arm's-length pricing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct procurement costs of raw matcha leaves, grinding and packaging costs, freight, customs duties and inventory write-downs, net of proper cost allocations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If goods are purchased from a foreign affiliate, the cost base must be supported by contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation. Non-resident related-party transactions above the legal threshold require a local file. A unilateral invoice without shipping, insurance, customs entry and payment records will trigger an adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible indirect taxes and surcharges such as urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge and local education surcharge, but not China's corporate income tax or expected withholding-tax liabilities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not report value-added tax as a CIT expense. If VAT is borne cross-border on royalties, the royalty gross-up and VAT treatment must be aligned with the withholding calculations; otherwise the same amount may be double counted or disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 / Line 4 through 6 (Selling, General and Administrative Expenses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, management expenses, and finance expenses, including matcha-certification fees, foreign travel, marketing, legal bills, bank charges and intercompany management fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees paid to the foreign parent must satisfy substance and benefit tests; management fees cannot simply relocate global overhead. The WFOE must withhold WHT on deductible royalties and interest paid abroad and obtain compliant invoices; otherwise the expense is non-deductible and the withholding obligation remains.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisions for diminution in value of inventory or receivables in the accounting books.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Accounting impairment is frequently non-deductible unless evidenced by extinguishment or an actual loss; excessive year-end transfer-price adjustments through provisions to foreign affiliates are a red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 / Line 8-10 (Operating Profit and Investment Gains)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fair-value changes, investment gains, then calculated operating profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends from a Chinese resident entity are exempt, whereas dividends from foreign subsidiaries may be taxable or eligible for a foreign tax credit. Gains from disposal of equity in an offshore SPV that derives its value from Chinese matcha operations may be recharacterized under General Anti-Avoidance Rules if the transaction lacks commercial substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 / Line 11-13 (Non-Operating Items and Total Accounting Profit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add non-operating income, deduct non-operating expenses, producing the total accounting profit line.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent payments such as penalties, loans written off, or unsupported sponsorship reduce accounting profit but must be disallowed in Line 14 adjustments. Confirm that any foreign-exchange gain on intercompany loans is fully recognized in taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Line 14-17 (Tax Adjustments and Taxable Income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add tax-adjustment increases such as non-deductible expenses, TP adjustments and disallowed losses; subtract tax-adjustment decreases such as tax-exempt income and R&D super deductions; subtract prior-year losses to reach taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the critical line for transfer-pricing corrections. Any under-reporting of arm's-length profit on the matcha resale margin must be adjusted here. The WFOE may not use foreign parent losses or global pooling to reduce Chinese taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 / Line 18-19 (Applicable Rate and Computed Tax)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 25% statutory CIT rate to taxable income and compute the tentative tax before exemptions and credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a standard WFOE distribution company, the rate is 25%; do not claim a 15% high-tech rate unless the company performs qualifying R&D. Any tax incentive must be supported by a filing schedule and eligibility certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 / Line 20-22 (Incentives and Actual Tax Liability)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct incentive amounts and tax credits to arrive at actual current-year CIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit limitations apply to income sourced abroad; the WFOE must file Schedule A108010 and retain foreign tax certificates. Dividends distributed to the foreign parent are not deductible and are not embedded in this line because they are subject to separate withholding in the remittance year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct quarterly advance CIT payments already made, arriving at final tax payable or overpayment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any refund will be applied to outstanding liabilities before remittance to the foreign parent. If the final return shows tax due and the company later distributes profit, the WFOE must settle the CIT first; a distribution without settled CIT creates a fraudulent dividend and withholding issue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form A100000 incurs a fine of RMB 2,000, up to RMB 10,000 for serious cases, plus an administrative penalty for late payment at 0.05% per day on the unpaid CIT under Tax Administration Law Articles 32 and 62. Understatements resulting from fraudulent or grossly negligent conduct may be penalized at 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under Article 63. Tax evasion exceeding RMB 50,000 and 10% of the tax payable may trigger criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201, including imprisonment and fines. In severe cross-border cases, the responsible director may also be added to the social-credit dishonesty list, subject to an exit ban and asset seizure.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on the gross amount of dividends paid by the WFOE to a non-resident enterprise parent, imposed by Enterprise Income Tax Law Articles 3(3) and 37. No underlying CIT credit attaches to the foreign parent; the 10% levy applies in addition to the 25% Chinese corporate income tax borne by the WFOE.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A treaty reduction such as 0%, 5% or 10% depending on the treaty and shareholding threshold is not automatic. The foreign parent must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) in its state of residence, complete the PRC treaty-benefit information forms or equivalent beneficial-ownership statements to the withholding agent and the State Taxation Administration, demonstrate that it is the beneficial owner of the shares and dividends and meets the limitation-on-benefits and principal-purpose tests, and maintain the WFOE's dividend record, board resolution, foreign registration certificate, shareholding chain and any recharacterization analysis. The treaty claim is typically processed at the time of withholding through the WFOE as withholding agent. Retroactive treaty relief may be claimed by refund within three years where over-withholding was borne, but beneficial ownership must still be proved. A foreign parent located in a zero-tax jurisdiction without employees, assets, management or business substance is treated as a shell, and the treaty claim will collapse.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident for the use of matcha brand labels, processing technology, know-how or software are subject to the statutory 10% CIT withholding plus 6% VAT and local surcharges on that VAT, absent treaty relief. Interest paid to a non-resident lender on cross-border debt is also subject to statutory 10% WHT; treaty rates usually range from 5% to 10% for interest and from 5% to 10% for royalties. A heavily debt-funded structure that converts profit into interest in a low-tax jurisdiction will be recharacterized as a dividend or dictated by thin-capitalization rules under CIT Law Article 46 and the Special Tax Adjustment Measures, exposing the entire amount to 10% dividend WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB 200 million in annual aggregate related-party transactions, or category-specific thresholds such as RMB 200 million for tangible property transfers and RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers, financial asset transfers, services, or related-party financing, trigger mandatory Local File preparation; the Master File is required when group consolidated revenue and transaction scale meet the thresholds announced in SAT Bulletin 2016 No. 42.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC is not an Economic Substance Regulations jurisdiction in the UAE sense, but CIT Law Articles 47 and 48, together with the Special Tax Adjustment Measures, impose a reasonable-business-purpose and substance-over-form doctrine. For organic-matcha trading, the Core Income-Generating Activities in China include purchase-order negotiation and execution, inventory and logistics management, product certification, risk-bearing over perishable goods, sales contracting with end customers, and revenue reconciliation. If the foreign parent merely books the margin while WFOE employees perform these functions, the Chinese tax authority will allocate profit to the WFOE under the arm's-length principle, impose a deemed distribution, and may apply 10% withholding tax on the recharacterized dividend. Functional, asset and risk analyses must be contemporaneous.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer-pricing shell and artificial profit shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is established with nominal capital, no employees, offices, risk control or distribution substance in China, while the foreign parent or affiliate books the actual matcha purchase and resale profit. The WFOE files minimal taxable income, pays disproportionate fees or royalties to a zero/low-tax associate, or prices its related-party sales below cost or outside the arm's-length range.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Special tax adjustment under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 48 and the Special Tax Adjustment Measures: the tax authority may reallocate profit to China, add statutory interest from the due date of the underpaid tax, and impose penalties under Tax Administration Law Articles 63 and 64. The lack of substance also invalidates any treaty benefit under the Principal Purpose Test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs false transfer-pricing documentation and board resolutions is treated as having knowingly caused the underpayment; civil joint and several liability arises when the director uses the limited-liability entity to defraud Chinese tax or creditors. Criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 applies if mispricing deliberately understates taxable income, with imprisonment of up to seven years, fines, asset seizure and an exit ban from China.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False invoicing, cash skimming and concealed overseas sales
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE uses fake VAT special invoices to inflate procurement costs, skims cash matcha sales, keeps export sales off the books, or remits proceeds to a foreign entity without recording the receivable, causing underreporting of CIT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax plus late surcharge under Tax Administration Law Article 63; false VAT invoicing is punishable under Criminal Law Article 205, and for large amounts, imprisonment can reach life plus property confiscation. Customs undervaluation of matcha imports and exports triggers customs penalties and administrative confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court will pierce the corporate veil where the director commingles corporate funds with personal funds and uses the WFOE as an alter ego. Under PRC Company Law Article 20, the director becomes jointly liable for unpaid tax, interest and penalties. Travel bans, asset seizure and the social-credit blacklist follow; a major fake-invoice scheme can lead to life imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unwithheld outbound dividend, interest or royalty remittance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE declares a dividend or pays interest or royalties to the foreign parent and remits the gross amount abroad without withholding the statutory 10%, or without substantiating treaty benefits through a TRC and beneficial-ownership evidence. It may also file a treaty claim while the foreign parent is a conduit in a zero-tax shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The withholding agent must pay the unwithheld tax out of its own funds under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 38; Tax Administration Law Article 69 imposes a fine of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld tax. If the treaty claim is denied, the WFOE must remit the 10% WHT plus interest and penalties; where a distribution is disguised as a loan, thin-capitalization rules may add deemed-dividend WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order remittance despite knowing of the withholding duty are personally liable for restitution of the State's tax loss. They are blocked from obtaining a tax-clearance certificate and placed on the exit-ban list, preventing departure from China. In willful evasion above the statutory threshold, the director faces criminal tax-evasion prosecution, imprisonment, confiscation of personal assets, and execution over personal bank accounts and equity in the foreign parent.
